claim.text: Is the statement described in this narrative hearsay under FRE 801(c)?

arguments.text: Bobby made the statement to a friend outside of the current proceeding.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) defines hearsay as a statement made out of court.

arguments.text: Bobby's statement that she believed she was Santa Clause constitutes an assertion of her belief.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) requires the declarant to assert a matter for the statement to qualify as hearsay.
arguments.evidence_span: she believed she was Santa Clause

arguments.text: The statement is not offered to prove that Bobby is actually Santa Claus, but rather to address her sanity.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) only applies if the statement is offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted.
arguments.evidence_span: On the issue of the sanity of Bobby

arguments.text: The statement is offered to demonstrate Bobby's state of mind regarding her sanity, which is a recognized non-hearsay purpose.
arguments.legal_rule: Statements offered to show a declarant's state of mind or mental condition are not offered for the truth of the matter asserted under FRE 801(c).
arguments.evidence_span: On the issue of the sanity of Bobby
